The prompt blatantly calls for teenagers in skimpy clothing and underwear. If nothing else, there should have been safeguards in place regarding the wording of the prompt itself, as other ai apps do. I can't support this app and can only recommend people to avoid it. I realize none will be perfect, but there are equally good and better alternatives that do make the effort to preserve human dignity by setting and enforcing community decency standards. I hope that either developers will respond to this by taking direct action in their app and website, or that they will be shut down. This is inexcusable.
